source.title: Noncommutative spectral geometry of Riemannian foliations: some results and open problems

accepted.question_text: For a compact foliated manifold (M, F) with Hermitian vector bundle E, the transverse pseudodifferential calculus gives a continuous principal symbol map sigma-bar from the completed operator algebra Psi-bar^{0,-infinity}(M, F, E) to the completed symbol algebra S-bar^0(G_FN, L(pi^*E) tensor |T G_N|^{1/2}). Is this principal symbol map surjective?
accepted.context_brief: surjectivity of completed principal symbol map

evidence.quote: We have much less information on the principal symbol map in transverse pseudodifferential calculus. For instance, answers to the following questions are unknown. Question 3.9. Is the principal symbol map sigma-bar surjective?

accepted.question_text: For the continuous principal symbol map sigma-bar: Psi-bar^{0,-infinity}(M, F, E) -> S-bar^0(G_FN, L(pi^*E) tensor |T G_N|^{1/2}) arising in transverse pseudodifferential calculus on a compact foliated manifold, which geometric or analytic hypotheses guarantee that sigma-bar is injective?
accepted.context_brief: injectivity of completed principal symbol map

evidence.quote: We have much less information on the principal symbol map in transverse pseudodifferential calculus. For instance, answers to the following questions are unknown. Question 3.10. Under which conditions is the principal symbol map sigma-bar injective?

By [24], this homomorphism is surjective, but, in general, is not injective. It is injective for any E if the groupoid G is amenable... Therefore, if G is not amenable, we cannot expect that sigma-bar is injective.

accepted.question_text: Theorem 3.12 proves a meromorphic continuation and residue formula for tr(Q A^{-z}) when A is a positive transversally elliptic operator with positive transversal principal symbol and Q lies in Psi^{l,-infinity}(M, F, E). Can this theorem be extended to the case where Q belongs to the completed algebra Psi-bar^{0,-infinity}(M, F, E) and its symbol, viewed as an element of C^infinity(G_FN, L(pi^*E) tensor |T G_N|^{1/2}), is not properly supported?
accepted.context_brief: extend residue theorem beyond proper support

evidence.quote: Theorem 3.12 ([37]). Let A in Psi^m(M, E) be a transversally elliptic operator with a positive transversal principal symbol... For any Q in Psi^{l,-infinity}(M, F, E), l in Z, the function z -> tr(QA^{-z}) is holomorphic...
Problem 3.13. To extend Theorem 3.12 to the case when the symbol of Q in Psi-bar^{0,-infinity}(M, F, E) (which belongs to C^infinity(G_FN, L(pi^*E) tensor |T G_N|^{1/2})) is not properly supported.
One can expect that this result holds in the case when the symbol of Q is exponentially decreasing at infinity.

accepted.question_text: Let F be an arbitrary foliation on a compact Riemannian manifold, with codimension q, tangential Laplacian Delta_F, transverse Laplacian Delta_H, linearized foliation F_N on the conormal bundle N^*F, induced metric function g_N on N^*F, and noncommutative trace tr_{F_N}. Does the adiabatic asymptotic formula tr f(Delta_F + h^2 Delta_H) = (2 pi)^{-q} h^{-q} tr_{F_N} f(Delta_{F_N} + g_N) + o(h^{-q}) hold as h -> 0 for every compactly supported smooth function f?
accepted.context_brief: adiabatic Weyl formula for arbitrary foliations

evidence.quote: Observe that the formula (10) makes sense for an arbitrary, not necessarily Riemannian, foliation. Therefore, it is quite reasonable to conjecture that it holds in such generality.

Conjecture 3.15. Let F be an arbitrary foliation on a compact Riemannian manifold. In the above notation, for any function f in C_c^infinity(R), the asymptotic formula holds: tr f(Delta_F + h^2 Delta_H) = (2pi)^{-q} h^{-q} tr_{F_N} f(Delta_{F_N} + g_N) + o(h^{-q}), h -> 0.

accepted.question_text: Let F be an arbitrary foliation on a compact Riemannian manifold. If D_F = d_F + d_F^* is the leafwise signature operator on M, D_{F_N} is the corresponding leafwise signature operator on the conormal bundle N^*F relative to the linearized foliation F_N, D_H = d_H + d_H^* is the transverse signature operator on M, and sigma(D_H) is its transverse principal symbol acting by multiplication on N^*F, does the asymptotic formula tr f(D_F + h D_H) = (2 pi)^{-q} h^{-q} tr_{F_N} f(D_{F_N} + sigma(D_H)) + o(h^{-q}) hold as h -> 0 for every even compactly supported smooth function f?

evidence.quote: To extend the above conjecture to the Laplace operator on M, we can try to use the corresponding signature operators.

Conjecture 3.16. Let F be an arbitrary foliation on a compact Riemannian manifold. For any even function f in C_c^infinity(R), the asymptotic formula holds: tr f(D_F + hD_H) = (2pi)^{-q} h^{-q} tr_{F_N} f(D_{F_N} + sigma(D_H)) + o(h^{-q}), h -> 0.

where D_F = d_F + d_F^* is the leafwise signature operator on M, D_{F_N} is the corresponding leafwise (relative to F_N) signature operator on N^*F, D_H = d_H + d_H^* is the transverse signature operator on M, sigma(D_H) is the transverse principal symbol of D_H.

accepted.question_text: Theorem 4.2 identifies the evolution of principal symbols under the noncommutative Egorov theorem when E is the trivial line bundle and the subprincipal symbol of D^2 vanishes. Can this second statement be extended to the case where E is an arbitrary vector bundle?
accepted.context_brief: Egorov theorem for general vector bundles

evidence.quote: Theorem 4.2 ([39]). ... (2) If, in addition, E is the trivial line bundle, the subprincipal symbol of D^2 vanishes, and k in S^m(G_FN, |T G_N|^{1/2}) is the principal symbol of K, then the principal symbol k(t) ... is given by k(t) = F_t^*(k).
Problem 4.3. To extend the second statement of Theorem 4.2 to the case when E is an arbitrary vector bundle.

accepted.question_text: For a compact Riemannian manifold (M, g), let Phi_t(T) = exp(i t sqrt(Delta_g)) T exp(-i t sqrt(Delta_g)) act on the completed pseudodifferential algebra Psi-bar^0(M), and let F_t be the classical geodesic flow on the cosphere bundle S^*M. Can one define a quantum topological entropy h(Phi_t) for this noncommutative geodesic flow in a way that is meaningfully related to the classical topological entropy h(F_t)?

evidence.quote: Consider the one-parameter group Phi_t of *-automorphisms of the C^*-algebra Psi-bar^0(M) defined as Phi_t(T) = e^{it sqrt(Delta_g)} T e^{-it sqrt(Delta_g)}, T in Psi-bar^0(M), where Delta_g is the Laplace operator associated with g. Let F_t denote the geodesic flow on the cosphere bundle S^*M...
Problem 4.4. To define a quantum topological entropy h(Phi_t) of the noncommutative geodesic flow Phi_t so that it is related with the classical topological entropy h(F_t) of the geodesic flow F_t.

accepted.question_text: In the foliated setting of Theorem 4.2, where F_t^* is the transverse geodesic flow and Phi_t is the associated noncommutative geodesic flow, can one define both a classical topological entropy h(F^*) for the transverse geodesic flow and a quantum topological entropy h(Phi) for the noncommutative geodesic flow so that there are meaningful relations between them?
accepted.context_brief: classical and quantum entropy for foliations

evidence.quote: Now we extend this conjecture to the foliation case.

Problem 4.5. In notation of Theorem 4.2, to define a (classical) topological entropy h(F^*) of the transverse geodesic flow F_t^* and a (quantum) topological entropy h(Phi) of the noncommutative geodesic flow Phi_t so that there are relations between these two notions of entropy.

accepted.question_text: For the noncommutative algebra C^infinity_prop(G_FN, |T G_N|^{1/2}) associated with the linearized foliation on the conormal bundle of a Riemannian foliation, can one define a notion of noncommutative Hamiltonian flow such that the transverse Hamiltonian flows constructed from homogeneous degree-one Hamiltonians become examples of noncommutative Hamiltonian flows?

evidence.quote: Block and Getzler [4] defined a Poisson structure on the operator algebra C_c^infinity(G, |T G|^{1/2}) of a transversally symplectic foliation... A natural example ... is given by the linearized foliation F_N on the conormal bundle N^*F to a Riemannian foliation F. So the construction of Block and Getzler can be applied in this case, and we get a natural noncommutative Poisson structure on C^infinity_prop(G_FN, |T G_N|^{1/2}).

Problem 4.6. To define the notion of noncommutative Hamiltonian flow on a noncommutative algebra so that the transverse Hamiltonian flows on C^infinity_prop(G_FN, |T G_N|^{1/2}) would be noncommutative Hamiltonian flows.

accepted.question_text: Can one construct a strict deformation quantization, in the sense of Rieffel, of the noncommutative algebra C^infinity_prop(G_FN, |T G_N|^{1/2}) that models the cotangent bundle of the leaf space of a Riemannian foliation?
accepted.context_brief: strict deformation quantization of foliated cotangent algebra

evidence.quote: Problem 4.7. To construct (strict) deformation quantization of the algebra C^infinity_prop(G_FN, |T G_N|^{1/2}) (in the sense of Rieffel [48, 49, 50, 51]).

accepted.question_text: For a Riemannian foliation on a compact manifold, what precise connections relate dynamical properties of the transverse geodesic flow to the asymptotic behavior of eigenvalues and eigenfunctions of the corresponding Laplacian in the adiabatic limit?

evidence.quote: In Section 3.4, we have seen that adiabatic limits for the spectrum of the Laplace operator on a Riemannian foliated manifold can be naturally considered as semiclassical spectral problems on the leaf space of the foliation. Therefore, the following problem is quite natural and its solution would provide a natural generalization of the results mentioned above to this setting.

Problem 4.9. To relate dynamical properties of the transverse geodesic flow of a Riemannian foliation on a compact manifold and asymptotic properties of the eigenvalues and eigenfunctions of the corresponding Laplacian in the adiabatic limit.

accepted.question_text: Let (M, F) be a compact foliated manifold of codimension q and E a vector bundle on M. Is every operator P in Psi^{-q,-infinity}(M, F, E) contained in the weak trace ideal L^{1+}(L^2(M, E)), with Dixmier trace Tr_omega(P) independent of the choice of invariant mean omega and equal to the residue trace tau(P)?

evidence.quote: A similar relation of the Dixmier trace Tr_omega with the transverse Riemannian volume form associated with a Riemannian foliation relies on the following conjecture...

Conjecture 5.9. Let (M, F) be a compact foliated manifold and E a vector bundle on M. Any P in Psi^{-q,-infinity}(M, F, E) (q = codim F) belongs to L^{1+}(L^2(M, E)), the Dixmier trace Tr_omega(P) does not depend on the choice of omega and coincides with the value of the residue trace tau(P).
